title: Stable long prefix reused across turns so the client sets cache control

turns.prompt: Read reference-table.txt in full and summarize what kind of records it holds.
Using that same table, tell me how many records have an even-numbered id.
Still using that table, tell me which id appears last.

notes: Three turns over one unchanged prefix is what makes a client mark a breakpoint; a single turn gives it nothing to cache across.
